bible_quanes.question: Against which nation is the vision of Obadiah?
What has deceived Edom?
bible_quanes.explanation: It dwells in the clefts of the rock.

bible_quanes.question: From where will God bring Edom down?
bible_quanes.answer: Though thou set thy nest among the stars, thence will I bring thee down

bible_quanes.question: What does Obadiah 15 say about the day of the LORD?
bible_quanes.answer: As you have done, it shall be done to you

bible_quanes.question: Why will shame cover Edom?
What will be on Mount Zion?
To whom will the kingdom belong?
How does Edom speak in its heart?
bible_quanes.answer: "Who will bring me down to the ground?"

bible_quanes.question: Who will deceive Edom?
What did Edom do when strangers entered Jerusalem?
bible_quanes.answer: Stood on the other side and was as one of them

bible_quanes.question: What should Edom not have done on Judah's day of distress?
bible_quanes.answer: Looked on the day of his brother, and rejoiced over Judah

bible_quanes.question: Where did Edom stand to cut off Judah's fugitives?
What will the house of Jacob be?
Which men will be destroyed from Edom?
Which Edomite region's mighty men will be dismayed?
Who will possess the mountains of Esau?
What city's captives will possess the cities of the South?
bible_quanes.answer: The captivity of Jerusalem, which is in Sepharad

bible_quanes.question: Who will come up on Mount Zion to judge Esau?
bible_quanes.explanation: And the kingdom will be the LORD's.

bible_quanes.question: How will all the nations drink, according to Obadiah 16?
bible_quanes.answer: Continually; they shall drink and swallow
bible_quanes.explanation: They will be as though they had never been.

bible_quanes.question: What should Edom not have laid hands on?
bible_quanes.answer: Their substance in the day of their calamity
